name: Eleanor Whitfield
psychographics: Prioritizes family time and mental wellness; skeptical of 'optimization' culture but appreciates practical shortcuts.
current_solutions: Relies on Ocado grocery delivery every Sunday and uses the 'Airfryer Mode' on her smart oven for quick dinners.
frustration: Ocado substituted her preferred organic free-range eggs with standard large eggs without asking, ruining her Sunday brunch plan for her partner's birthday, and she had to drive to the store at 2 PM to fix it.
decision_style: Reads the first three reviews on Trustpilot, checks the return policy, then buys; rarely switches brands once she trusts them.
voice: Rambling and detailed; uses legal analogies when describing problems; often apologizes unnecessarily even when describing a vendor's mistake.
